description:
Jensen Huang the SI Father (FATHER) honors NVIDIA founder — Jensen Huang — and his GPU revolution, which built a solid foundation for super intelligence (SI). Without his leadership, humanity's path to SI may differ. 

NOW, launched on AtlantisChain — the world’s ONLY ultra-super-fast Layer-0 blockchain with 3,600,000 TPS and 0.031-second block time — FATHER is a LASTING on-chain tribute to his SI contribution, honoring his legacy, inspiring a global SI rush, and honoring future SI worldwide.
name: Jensen Huang the SI Father
